items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: This is how I first met Flip. We were working with Frankie Newton

ctx.x: Oh, the pay was beautiful. And I mention that because of Flip Phillips. This is how I first met Flip. We were working with Frankie Newton, another marvelous trumpet player. He's the style of Roy Eldridge. I'm surprised you haven't heard of him.
I may have heard of him, but I don't know his playing. (Inaudible).
